demo.title: mangrove-x402.sh
demo.code:
# Free: list signals, no key and no payment
curl https://api.mangrovedeveloper.ai/api/v1/signals/

# Pay per call in USDC on Base (0.005 USDC at the time of writing)
bankr x402 call https://api.mangrovedeveloper.ai/api/v1/crypto-assets/global-market --max-payment 0.05

# Market regime for one asset (0.02 USDC at the time of writing)
bankr x402 call https://api.mangrovedeveloper.ai/api/v1/market-data/regime/BTC --max-payment 0.05

setup: Install the skill with the button below
No account needed: Mangrove calls are paid per call in USDC on Base through x402, from your Bankr wallet
Or get a free Mangrove API key at https://mangrovedeveloper.ai and send it as a Bearer token
Say: "what is the global crypto market snapshot on Mangrove?" - the agent shows the price and asks before paying
